The spring market is my favorite place. Kate often helps me with history. Sam's favorite subject is history. What's more, I take off my shoes at the door.
Sam usually eats soup for lunch. After school, we play together. I like my life very much. We got tickets for the concert.
Kate likes soup too. I am happy every day. Sam and Kate are in the same class.
